tasks.title: Create About page component with navigation and tests
tasks.description:
1. WHAT: Create a new About page component that displays an 'About' heading and a short descriptive paragraph, styled to match the existing design system, and integrate it into the authenticated section of App.tsx with navigation to/from the Calculator view.

2. READ FIRST: Read src/App.tsx (state-based routing pattern — authenticated view currently only shows Calculator, view state for unauthenticated is 'login' | 'signup'), src/components/Login.css (CSS variable usage: --app-bg, --calculator-bg, --app-text, --calculator-shadow, etc.), src/App.css (global styles and CSS variable definitions), src/components/Calculator.tsx (structure of authenticated component), src/App.test.tsx (existing tests to understand what to add), src/components/Login.test.tsx (test pattern to follow).

3. FILES TO CREATE:
   - src/components/About.tsx — new About page component
   - src/components/About.css — styles matching design system
   - src/components/About.test.tsx — tests for About component

4. FILES TO MODIFY:
   - src/App.tsx — add 'about' to authenticated view state (e.g., `appView: 'calculator' | 'about'`), add an 'About' navigation link in the Calculator view, and render <About /> when appView is 'about'
   - src/App.test.tsx — add tests for the About navigation link and About page rendering

5. APPROACH:
   - About.tsx: Export named function `About` that accepts `onBack: () => void` prop. Render a container div with an h1 'About' heading, a descriptive paragraph (e.g. 'Crunchy Number Muncher is a lightweight calculator app built with React and TypeScript. It supports basic arithmetic operations with a clean, accessible interface.'), and a back button that calls onBack.
   - About.css: Use the same CSS variable tokens as Login.css (--app-bg, --calculator-bg, --app-text, --calculator-shadow). Create an .about-container (centered, min-height 100vh, background --app-bg), .about-card (max-width 480px, padding 2rem, background --calculator-bg, border-radius 12px, box-shadow --calculator-shadow), .about-title (color --app-text, font-size 1.5rem, font-weight 700), .about-text (color --app-text, line-height 1.6), .about-back (same button style as .login-submit but with a secondary/neutral style).
   - App.tsx: Add `const [appView, setAppView] = useState<'calculator' | 'about'>('calculator')` in the authenticated section. In the authenticated JSX, conditionally render either Calculator with an 'About' link/button or the About component. Pass `onBack={() => setAppView('calculator')}` to About.
   - About.test.tsx: Follow the pattern in src/components/Login.test.tsx. Test: renders heading 'About', renders descriptive paragraph text, calls onBack when back button is clicked.
   - App.test.tsx: Add tests that the app renders an 'About' navigation element after login.

6. PATTERNS: Follow the named export pattern (`export function About`) as used by all other components. Follow the CSS variable pattern from Login.css exactly.
acceptance_criteria: An 'About' navigation link or button is visible on the Calculator page after logging in
Clicking the About link shows a page with a visible 'About' heading
The About page shows a descriptive paragraph about the calculator app
A back button on the About page returns the user to the Calculator view
The About page background, text color, and card styling visually match the Login and Calculator pages
